name: Slow-Cooked Beef Ragù with Pappardelle
description: Chunks of braising beef cooked low and slow in red wine and tomatoes until they fall apart into a rich sauce. Worth it for a weekend.
recipeIngredient: 1 kg braising beef, cut into large chunks

itemListElement.text: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Season the beef and brown it in batches in the oil in a large casserole. Set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and tomato purée and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and bubble for a few minutes, then add the tomatoes, bay leaves and beef. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook in the oven for 3 hours, stirring once or twice, until the beef shreds easily. Break it up with two forks.
Cook the pappardelle in salted water until al dente. Reserve a mug of the cooking water, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the ragù, loosening with a little pasta water. Serve with parmesan.
